brief:
A thirteen-year-old Palestinian child was injured by live fire from Israeli forces during a military raid into Zababdeh, a town south of Jenin in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. The shooting occurred on Sunday as Israeli troops conducted operations in the area.

Further details about the child's condition and the circumstances of the incident were not immediately available.

title: Israeli forces shoot child during West Bank raid near Jenin
